name: Neural Network Sketch-Based Specification
aliases: Tzeng et al. Neural Network TF
definition: A technique using a neural network to adjust the FT based on a sketch drawn on a volume visualization, training the network to emphasize marked regions.
summary: Neural Network Sketch-Based Specification uses a neural network to learn multidimensional transfer functions from user sketches, distinguishing itself by replacing manual tuning with learned visual mappings.
